decisions.reason: The biodynamic yogurt extends the firm's established Demeter range and builds on related organic dairy knowledge, so the firm can interpret results and improve it, in line with its absorptive capacity.
Mild sliced cheese is close to the firm's existing cheese-making expertise and own R&D supports learning from early market results.
Sliced butter cheese leverages the firm's established dairy and cheesemaking knowledge, enabling the firm to assimilate feedback and refine the product.
